tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bde chen chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang / /sna tshogs gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /dpal mgon bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /dbyer med lhag pa'i lha yis bdag skyongs shig /gsang chen snying po'i lam bzang kye rdo rje'i/ /nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i man ngag gnad/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du/ /'chad par 'gyur gyis mkha' 'gros skabs phyes shig /de la 'dir gang bshad par bya ba ni/ /gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gsang sngags bla na med pa'i lam srol 'di skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis gdul bya'i dbang po dang 'tshams par bkral ba'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba mang du mchis mod/ 'jigs bral rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i gsung ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi sgo nas bkri tshul ni/ gang zag mchog dman thams cad 'jug tu rung ba'i lam yin pas/ lta bsgom spyod gsum dang po tha dad du phyes nas rang gi rgyud tshod dang bstun te nyams su blang du rung bas lam dus thun bzhi'i nyams len da lta sa skya pa'i rjes 'jug thams cad kyis zhal 'don mdzad pa phyag len la'ang yod/ 'brel tshad don ldan gyi chos yin pas phan yon yang che bar gzhir bcas/ des na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngon 'gro dngos gzhi thams cad rang gis gang shes dang bstun nas nyams su len pa yin/ gang zag 'bring bsgom don ha lam tsam ma yin par bla ma las 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngo sprod zhib tu thob cing rang gis kyang de bzhin du nyams su blangs pas tha na go yul tsam du lta bsgom spyod gsum gcig tu dril nas nyams su len nus pa'i tshe lam dus kyi dmigs pa 'di bzhin dgos so zhes chos rje rdo rje 'chang 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs pa rin po che'i dgongs pa chos rje nyid kyi bka' drin las rnyed pa rnam bshad rnams su gsal kha cher ma mdzad pa rnams sgro skur dang bral bar mthong thos kyi bshad yams bsdus pa ma yin par gnad don snying po dril nas brjod na/

kho bos byas pa'i lam rim smon lam du/ dang por lta bsgom spyod la rim gyis zhugs/ /bar du gsum po gnad thog gcig tu dril/ /tha mar bsam brjod bral ba'i ye shes su/ /thams cad ro mnyam rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ de dang de 'dra'i rnam dbye legs shes na/ /'khor 'das thun mong chos bdun so so dang / /gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len tshul sogs/ /mang po'i don la blo gros gsal bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rnams las tshig mang nyung ci rigs pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa rnams kyi don rje bla mas brtse bas gdams par mdzad pa lam zab mo'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum thams cad lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtsis zin pa'i dbang du byas te/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i don gyi bcud phyung ba gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa yongs rdzogs sgrub pa po'i stan thog gcig gi nyams len la tshang bas/ lam gyi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro lta bu la'ang zab chos kyi gnad thams cad bsdus nas nyams su len tshul ni/ theg chen spyi'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro ni gzhan du gsal la/ gsang chen bla na med pa'i myur lam 'di'i skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du kye rdo rje lha dgu gsal btab la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yi dam dbyer med sangs rgyas/ de'i thugs rgyud kyi rgyud sde bzhi dang rim pa gnyis sogs chos/ 'khor lha mo brgyad dge 'dun dkon mchog nyi zer du gtso bo'i rgyab be ta lī'i mdun du gsung rab pusti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bur gsungs pa ni las dang po pa'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ched tsam yin/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs mkhas yin pas bsgoms na legs/ don du snang sems bsres nas skyabs yul gyi thugs rgyud kyi chos dkon mchog gnad dril nas rang rgyud la 'dzin shes dgos/

mdun gyi bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med la sku bzhi ye shes lnga mkhyen brtse nus gsum sogs yon tan thams cad mnga' bar thag bcad/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du khyed shes blo gtad kyis skyabs su 'gro dgos/ rang la bla mas 'khor 'das dbyer med ngo sprad pa ltar/ skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis/ /stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang / /zhes pa'i lta ba'i ngang nas ma g.yos par bla ma dang yi dam rang las phyi rol du mu stegs pa'i lha ltar mnyes na dngos grub stsol zhing ma mnyes na mi 'byung ba de lta bur mi 'dzin par bla ma dkon mchog kyang rang sems dag pa'i snang brnyan tsam du shes nas bskyab bya skyob byed tha dad med par skyabs su 'gro ba rgyu'i skyabs 'gro yin/ rang sems dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro yin pas rgyu'i skyabs 'gro la 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gros rgyas thebs pa 'di gnad du che/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes su rtogs pa de 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro med na mi skye bas/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ bla na med pa'i skyabs 'gro la brten nas gsang sngags kyi sdom pa skye zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i skyabs 'gro'i gnad zin na snang gsum rgyud gsum gyi nyams len gyi gnad thams cad tshang ba yin te/ bskyab bya rang dang sems can thams cad ma dag pa'i snang ba'am kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ skyabs yul dag pa'i snang ba'am 'bras rgyud/ bskyab bya skyob byed tha dad med par shes pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba gzhi 'bras bsre ba'i man ngag nyams kyi snang ba'am lus thabs rgyud yin no/ dkon mchog gsum rang sems la tshang tshul/ ye shes grub pa las/ dag thob bral ba'i sems sangs rgyas/ /mi 'gyur dri med chos dang ni/ /yon tan lhun rdzogs dge 'dun nyid/ /yin phyir rang gi sems nyid mchog /ces gsungs so/

/snang gsum lam gyi gzhi bca' ltar bshad pa las dang po pa bkri ba'i phyir mdo phyogs kyi nyams len tsam la sbyar ba yin la/ sngags kyi nyams len la sbyar te bshad pa snang gsum rang rkang gi bkri tshul yin no/ /sems bskyed ni/ bla mas rang la ngo sprad pa ltar 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems su thag bcad/ de'ang 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang thams cad ma dag pa'i gnas skabs kyi rig pa'i 'char sgo tsam yin la/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams snang thams cad sems cung zad dag pa'i 'char sgo tsam dang / sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba thams cad rang sems dag pa'i snang brnyan tsam yin/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum du bzhag pa de'ang dus gsum dus med du shes na da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma 'di las logs na med/ sems de'ang sgyu ma/ rten 'brel brjod bral du shes pa'i rig stong gi ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de nas kye ma rtogs na sems can thams cad sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba las mi 'da' yang / ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams rigs drug gi 'khrul snang du ma la longs spyod pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ bdag gis da res mtshan ldan gyi bla ma las rnyed pa'i tshe lus gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag zab mo tshang la ma nor ba 'di lta bu nyams su blangs la ma rgan sems can thams cad zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la dgod par bgyi'o snyam pa'i ngang nas sems bskyed kyi tshig rnams 'don/ gzhung gi tshig zin la smon 'jug gnyis tsam yod/ 'di bzhin nyams su blangs na kun rdzob dang don dam gyi sems bskyed gnyis dang smon 'jug gnyis tshang bar ma zad sdom pa gsum dang phar phyin drug sogs lam gnad mang po tshang zhing gnad zin na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis kyang gnad gcig tu 'gro ba yin no/ /rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' gzhung bzhin bskyed/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med du spyi bor bsgom pa 'di la/

tho brtsegs su bsgom pa dang / khrom tshogs su bsgom pa dang / kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom pa gsum las 'dir phyi ma yin/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyan cha dang / bzhugs stangs dang / gdan dang bcas pa'i dag pa shes nas bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su ngo shes pa 'di gnad che/ las dang po pas bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa dang sbrags nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas sdig ltung bshags sdom byed pa yin la/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i ngang nas 'don na/ 'bras rgyud dag pa gnyis ldan gyi bla ma yi dam da byer med spyi bor bsgom/ rgyu rgyud sems can la nyon mongs pa la ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes gsungs pa'i sems can la zhes pas gzhi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'am phung khams skye mched bstan/ nyon mongs pa la zhes pas rgyu nyon mongs pa dug gsum sogs bstan/ ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes pas spyir thams cad bstan mod nad gdon sdig sgrib gsum du 'du bas bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi tshe rnag khrag dang ljan ljin sdom sdig sbal lcong dud khu sol khu rnams kyi rnam pas rgyu gzhi ngo bo gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bshang gci'i lam dang rkang mthil gnyis nas phyir 'thon pas ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su sbyangs nas/ de nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum dang log 'tsho sogs lus dang rtsa'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi dang yi ge'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ longs sku'i sa bon bzhag snying ga yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi mi dge ba gsum dang thig le'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ chos sku'i sa bon bzhag lus thams cad gang /

dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum cha mnyam rlung dang bcas pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon bzhag dbang bzhi blang ba'i dmigs pa dang sbrags te yig brgya zhog 'phral/ mgon po bdag ni sogs kyis stobs bzhi gsal gdab/ de yang mgon po zhes pas rten gyi stobs/ bdag ni sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ bla ma mgon po sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de man chad kyis sor chud pa'am slar mi ldog pa'i stobs bstan pa yin no/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bstim ste rgyud gsum dbyer med du shes pa'i lta ba'i ngang la 'jog de'ang nad gdon sdig sgrib gsum la ma dag pa'i snang ba 'du tshul/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug gsum las nyon mongs pa dug gsum skye/ de las nad gsum gdon gsum sogs 'byung tshul la go ba chags na 'di shes par sla la/ spyir dbang bshad rnams su phung khams skye mched kyi 'khrul snang dang ma bral gyi bar la yang dag pa'i ye shes mi skye bar gsungs pa la legs par dpyad na phung khams skye mched rnams nad gdon sdig sgrib gsum las logs na med de/ phyi'i bar chad gdon gsum/ nang gi bar chad nad gsum/ gsang ba'i bar chad dug gsum gyi snang ba shar ba la phung khams skye mched kyi rnam dbye byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud gsum bsres nas sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba 'di la sbyang gzhi gzugs phung ngan pa bden grub zhig sbyong byed rnam snang bzang po bden grub zhig tu bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi ldan gyi tshul du bsgom pa de las dang po pa'i sgom tshul yin/ gzugs phung zhes pa rang sems kyi 'khrul snang yin/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug tu shes pa me long lta bu'i ye shes sam chos dbyings ye shes kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par snang mdzad zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du shar bar shes pa lta thog nas bsgom pa tshol ba'i nyams len yin/

dper na da lta'i rang rgyud kyi sdig pa zhes pa 'di'ang dge ba'i lam du bkol du mi btub pa'i rnam rtog 'di las logs na med/ rnam rtog skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang du mnyam par 'jog nus na/ sdig pa'i rang bzhin shes pa bshags pa'i mchog ces yang dgon pas gsungs pa ltar sdig sbyong la'ang 'di las zab pa med ces bla mas yang yang gsungs/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga gsal btab nas dbang bzhi'i dmigs pa sgom tshe rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'i snyigs ma ma dag pa'i snang ba rnams sbyang bar bsams na phyis rdzogs rim bsgom pa thams cad kyi smin byed du 'gro zhing de la rtsub nyams rnams mi 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod pas ma brjed gsungs/ dpyad bsgom dang 'jog bsgom gnyis res mos byed dgos pas dang po rig stong spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la bcas bcos med par mnyam par 'jog 'khor gsum gyi rnam rtog dang phyi'i yul snang 'di rnams gang las byung snyam pa'i rtog pa shar na phyi nang bsre ba 'di gnad du che bas/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhir rlung sems rgyu 'grul gyi dbang gis gdugs nam mkha' la 'phyar bas grib ma sa la shar ba ltar snang ba 'di rnams byung ba yin snyam nas phyi nang bsres nas bsgom la spros pa bcad/ gzung 'dzin rgyang chad du shor nas 'dre gdon gyi snang ba shar tshe da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma yul yul can gnyis su snang ba 'di 'dre 'dzin gyi rtog pas bslad na 'dre gdon yang 'di las logs na med/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang dang sdug bsngal thams cad 'di las 'byung bas nyon mongs pa dang sdig sgrib kyang 'di rang yin/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta bas lta yul yang 'di nyid yin/ zab gsal gnyis med kyi bskyed rdzogs bsgom yul yang 'di nyid yin/ blang dor gnyis med kyi spyod pa'i yul yang 'di nyid yin/ rang ngo shes na sku dang ye shes kyang 'di rang yin par shes pa'i ngang nas snang sems bsres la spros pa bcad/

'khor 'das kyi snang ba gang la'ang zhen pa skyes tshe dbyings rig bsres la ma bcos par 'jog sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar nas bsgom pa la zhugs tshe dag snang mtshan nyid pa ma skyes na 'bras dus dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sku dang ye shes kyang da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma rang ngo legs par shes pa las logs na med par shes nas gzhi 'bras bsre ba 'di gnad du che bas gnad 'di rnams mi brjed par lam gyi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi gnas skabs thams cad du rang rgyud kyi rtog pa skyes tshul la dpags nas nyams len lam du bsrel shes dgos pa yin no/ /de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa la/ rang skad cig gis kye rdo rjer bskyed/ de'ang skad cig gis zhes pa rig pa skad cig ma ngo shes na gdod nas kye rdo rje yin pa gsal thebs pa yin/ thugs ka'i gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa de skyabs yul rnams rang sems dag pa'i gzugs brnyan yin pas rang ngo shes pa'i lta ba'i ngang nas mdun bskyed gsal 'debs pa 'di gnad che zhes pa'i don yin/ de la thog mar phyag 'tshal ba'ang / bdag mdun tha dad du 'dzin pa med par/ rim lnga las/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / /ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin/ /rang gis rang gi ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang de 'dir phyag yin/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis phyag bya/ mchod pa'ang / ma dag pa'i snang ba bdud rtsi lnga sogs dag pa ye shes lnga'i ngo bor shes nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba dran bzhin du mchod/ yan lag bdun pa bya ba'i tshe spyir don yod grub pa'i sbyang gzhi 'du byed kyi phung po de'i nang na sdig pa'ang yod pas dag snang gi sgo nas sdig sbyong mdzad tshul yang yod mod/ 'di'i yan lag bdun pa 'di so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa gsar du len pa dang / nyams pa gso ba'i thabs khyad par can yin pas dang po sdig pa stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags/

rjes su yi rang phrag dog med par gzhan gyi dge ba la spro ba yin mod/ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi lta bas zin na phrag dog ye mi 'byung / skyabs 'gro byas pas dge bsnyen nas dge slong gi bar gyi so thar gyi sdom pa rang rgyud na gang yod thob cing gso nus pa dang / smon 'jug gnyis kyi sdom pa'ang de bzhin du shes dgos/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung skabs/ tshul khrims gsum gzhung na gsal ba ltar dang / 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba dang sbyar na/ gya nom lhar zhen dang bcas pa'i mtshan rtog thams cad spong ba nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin dge ba chos sdud/ snying rje'i rtsi dang ma bral ba sems can don byed du 'gro ba yin/ nang gi dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro tshul/ slob bshad pas/ gsal ba dge 'dun/ stong pa chos/ zung 'jug sangs rgyas su gsungs pa dang / tshogs bshad pas rang sems spros pa dang bral ba sangs rgyas/ de rtogs pa med pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa chos/ de nyams su len pa dge 'dun zhes gsungs pa gnyis gnad gcig yin te/ sems kyi stong nyid spros pa dang bral ba de sems kyi gsal cha des so so rang rig pa'i tshul gyis nyams su myong ba sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtsa bar/ gsal ba sprul sku stong pa chos kyi sku/ /zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin la/ /zhes pa dang / khrid yig las sku gsum rang ngo 'phrod ces gsungs pa'ang 'di nyid yin no/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya gsum spyir gzhung na gsal ba ltar yin mod/ lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes dang ma bral na gnad der 'du ba yin no/ /slob dpon 'dzin tshul bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su shes dgos pa yin/ sbyin pa bzhi po rang gi nyams len la tshang tshul dang / theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i dam chos 'dzin pa yang rang gi nyams len gcig pu la tshang ba yin pas mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i don gyi bcud phyung ba gsungs pa yin/

sdom pa thams cad dang ldan pa zhes gsungs pa'i tshig gi nus pas sor byang gnyis su ma zad sngags sdom yang bzung la mtshan rtog thams cad dang bral ba'i sngags sdom 'di snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shes pa yin/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyang 'di las logs na med par shes dgos/ mdor na rigs lnga'i sdom gzung 'dis gsang sngags kyi nyams len nam sdom pa khas blangs kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa yin no/ tshad med bzhi sgom skabs/ 'od zer dang lha mo spro ba de gzhi lam 'bras gsum bsres nas sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar te lam byed bzhi ldan du bsgoms na 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba dang 'grigs pa yin no/ /srung 'khor ni/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la khyod kyis rdor sems bsgom bzlas kyi bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gis sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang / srung 'khor gyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dmigs pa byas pa gnyis lta ba'i gnad zin na sdig pa 'dag pa la khyad par med pas rem la bsgom dgos zhes gsungs/ spyir srung 'khor 'di ye shes tshogs bsags thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas gzugs kyi rnam par bsgom pa yin/ spang bya gnyen po shar/ bdud rigs bar chad srung 'khor du shar zhes pa'i go don slong thub dgos/ des na ye shes tshogs bsags kyi skabs su/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi snang ba thams cad lus kyi rtsa yig rnams su rlung sems kyi rgyu 'grul gyis dbang gis snang ba yin/ de thams cad da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma 'di la tshang zhing / sems rig pa skad cig ma de brtags na skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral zhing / ngo shes na rig stong brjod du med pa'i chos nyid las nam yang mi g.yo ba yin/ de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs sna tshogs rdo rjer bsgoms pa nas srung 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bsgoms nas sngags bzla ba nyi zer du gsal la/ der zhal gsal ma mdzad pa dbang bshad chen mor/

gti mug gti mug longs spyod pas/ /gti mug zad pa gshin rje gshed/ /de ni phung po'i mthar byed de/ /de ni shes bya mthar byed do/ /zhe sdang zhe sdang longs spyod pas/ /zhe sdang zad pa shes rab mthar/ /de ni sems kyi mthar byed de/ /de ni nyon mongs mthar byed 'gyur/ /'dod chags 'dod chags longs spyod pas/ /'dod chags zad pa pad mthar byed/ /de ni ngag gi mthar byed de/ /de ni snyoms 'jug mthar byed do/ /nyon mongs kun zad gang yin dang / /de bzhin las kun zad pa nyid/ /sgrib pa kun zad ye shes ni/ /bgegs ni mthar byed ces byar bshad/ /ces gsang 'dus kyi lung drangs pa'i dgongs pa bzhin dmigs rim cung zad bshad na/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / phyogs bcur khro bo bcu bsgom pa thams cad bdag bskyed yin/ des na lha'i nga rgyal bsgom pas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin 'joms nus na gti mug gis gti mug la bsnun te lam du khyer ba'i don yin/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ yig gi klad kor gyi nang du bla ma/ rang nyid nang du/ mdun du pha ma sogs bsgom pa 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags la bsnun te lam du khyer ba dang / 'khor lo'i rtsib bar brgyad du dgra bgegs bsgom nas bsgral ba 'di zhe sdang gis zhe sdang la bsnun te lam du khyer ba ste/ snang bas mi 'ching zhen pas 'ching / gsungs pa bzhin lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du rnam pa 'di bzhin sgom tshe bdag 'dzin gyis ma gos shing de la chags sdang yang mi 'byung bas nyon sgrib spong la/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral na shes sgrib spong zhing / de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la bying rgod kyi rtog pas ma bslad na snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa spong nus pa gsang sngags kyi thabs la mkhas pa yin/ de'ang khro bo bcu gcig po 'bras dus kyi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi snang brnyan yin par shes pa'i dag snang dang bsgom tshul gyi rnam pa 'di rnams sbyang gzhi dang mthun pas ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang thams cad lam du khyer nus/

ji ltar lam du khyer na/ gzhi 'bras gnyis po de lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngang du ro gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len pa yin/ gnod bya nang na med/ gnod byed phyi na med pa'i sgo nas srung 'khor nyams su len dgos/ rig stong gnyis med kyi ye shes ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ til gyi shun pa lta bu'i zug rngus kyang / /nam zhig sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten chos brgyad dang / /'khor 'das gnyis bcas gang la'ang zhen pa med par rnam pa tsam lam du khyer ba la bzlas pa'i mjug tu hūm̐ bcus khro bo bcu gsal 'debs gsungs pa'ang 'di la dgongs pa yin/ srung ba'i 'khor los bar chad bsrung / /srod la bdud btul lam du byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa'o/ /dngos gzhi yan lag drug gi gzhal yas khang gi skabs su/ dang por bsre ba bzhi tshang bar byas nas 'khor 'das dbyer med bsgom/ de la rnam thar sgo gsum tshang dgos pas gzhi stong pa nyid/ lam mtshan ma med pa/ 'bras bu smon pa med pa gsum dus gcig la bsgom/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang mdo phyogs ltar rim can du bsgom pa ma yin par/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba 'di la sbyor shes dgos pas lta ba la mi 'phrog pa'i yid ches rnyed pa dad pa/ de la spro ba brtson 'grus/ mi brjed pa dran pa/ rang ngo shes pa shes rab/ de las mi g.yo ba ting 'dzin yin pas dbang po dang stobs lnga tshang la/ dran pa nyer bzhag shes rab/ yang dag spong ba brtson 'grus/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ting nge 'dzin du 'du la/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi dga' ba shin sbyangs btang snyom gsum rang sems ma bcos pa'i nyams len la goms pa'i phan yon tsam yin/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i ngag yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' gsum don gyis tshang ba la dgongs/

bden bzhi lto sbyar nas sdug bsngal bden pa 'gog bden sku dang / kun 'byung bden pa lam bden ye shes su 'char ba la 'khor 'das dbyer med zer ba yin/ de'ang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i rtsi dang ma bral ba zhig nges par dgos/ de lta bu'i nang gi nyams len gyi gzugs brnyan phyir shar ba snod gzhal yas khang bcud lhag pa'i lhar snang ba'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad 'di shes bzhin du bsgom dgos/ de ltar bsgoms na rig pa skad cig ma 'di'i steng du 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad tshang bas gzhal yas khang bsgom yang 'bras dus kyi sku dang ye shes kyi dag snang dang lam gyi nyams len gyi gnad thams cad tshang dgos pas/ de'ang phyogs gcig la mtshon nas mdor bsdus tsam bshad na/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga gzhi dang sbyar na dug lnga phung po lnga sbyong la/ lam dang sbyar na dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga'i dag pa mtshon la/ 'bras bu dang sbyar na ye shes lnga dang sku lnga'ang yin pas nyi zer du snang gsum rgyud gsum gyi nyams len thams cad rig pa skad cig ma la tshang gsungs pa'ang de yin no/ /gzhan yang dur khrod brgyad kyis ma dag pa 'khor ba mtshon/ gzhal yas khang gis lam mtshon/ lha dgus 'bras bu mtshon gsungs pa'ang rnal 'byor pas gzhi lam 'bras gsum gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len pa'i gzugs brnyan phyir shar ba yin pas de gsum la lha dang ye shes yin min gyi khyad par med pa zhig go dgos/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo zhes pa ye shes lnga mngon du byas pa'i brda yin/ de'i steng du bdud bzhi brtsegs mar bsgom pa de nyams len de lta bu dang ldan na bdud bzhi'i skyon gyis mi gos par zhabs 'og tu non yod zer ba'i brda yin/ de nas mngon byang lngas lha bskyed pa la/ zla zer las/ mdor na rgyu dus kyi lus sems gnyis mngon byang lnga'i tshul du rang grub tu yod pa ni sbyang gzhi yin la/

de la gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes gnyis mngon byang lnga'i tshul du bskur bas bskyed rim gyi mngon byang lnga 'grub pa'i rgyu byed la/ lam du bskyed rim gyi lha rnams mngon byang lnga'i tshul gyis bsgom pa rdzogs rim gnyis kyi dge rtsa smin byed du 'gro la des rdzogs rim bsgom pas 'bras bu ye shes lnga mngon du gyur nas 'tshang rgya ba yin pas 'di rnams rgyu 'bras su 'gro ba'i bshad pa shes dgos kyi/ mtshon don bsgrigs pa tsam gyi bshad pa la snying po med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don mngal skyes gtso bo'i dbang du byas nas bshad na/ pha ma'i khu khrag gnyis dang bar do'i rnam shes gsum 'dzom ste brgyal nas rten dkyil 'khor bzhi rim gyis 'phel te lus grub pa mngon byang lnga yin la/ 'chi ba'i tshe dkar lam dmar lam nag lam rnams shar te/ 'od gsal ngos ma zin par brgyal nas slar yang bar do'i yid lus grub ste lus len pa gzhi dus kyi mngon byang yin no/ /da lta lus gnas pa'i tshe ro rkyang gnyis khyi khams dkar dmar gyi dbang gis phyi rol nyi zla'i snang ba dang rtog pa sna tshogs pa gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba dang bcas pa shar ba phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi dbang gis snang ba yin pas/ de lta bu'i gzhi dus kyi mngon byang la gsang dbang dang sher dbang gnyis ye shes lnga'i mngon byang don gyis tshang ba'i thabs shes zung 'jug mngon byang lnga ldan gyi tshul du bskur nas/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su phyi nang gi rten 'brel dang gzhi 'bras bsre ba'i thabs kyis mngon byang lnga bsgoms na bskyed rim de rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du'ang 'gro zhing / rje btsun gyis/ ye shes zhabs lugs kyis bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyi rgyas btab nas bsgoms par gsungs pa la cung zad thugs ma mnyes pa lta bur mdzad pa 'di 'dra'i gnad kyis ma zin pa la dgongs shing / mdo phyogs kyi lam gyis snang gsum 'pho ba'i bag chags mi sbyong zhing sngags kyis sbyong bar gsungs pa bskyed rim gyi dus na'ang gnad 'di 'dras zin pa dang /

rdzogs rim rang byin rlabs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gnyis dang rdo rje rba rlabs kyis sbyong zhing lam dus kyi snang bzhi'i ye shes zung 'jug dang bcas pa'ang mngon byang lnga yin zhing / 'bras dus kyi sku dang ye shes kyang 'di las logs na med pas ye shes lnga dus gcig tu bsgom shes dgos pas de'i tshul ni/ ye shes grub pa las/ ji ltar me long gzugs brnyan la/ /rang nyid nges par snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin chos sku'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /snang bas me long zhes bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma gzung 'dzin gyi sgrib g.yog dang bral ba 'di bcas bcos ma shor bar rang babs su 'jog shes na me long lta bu'i ye shes de yin/ de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes dang / /rang gi dang ni 'gro ba'i yang / /dngos nyid gcig par thugs chud pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mnyam nyid ye shes kyang de yin/ gdod nas dag cing skye ba med/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes gang / /so sor rtog pa can zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang de yin/ kun nas kun tu sangs rgyas kyi/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa la 'jug pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mdzad gcig pa/ /bya ba grub pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bya grub ye shes de rang ngo shes pa'i nyams len la don gyis tshang mod/ rang gis sems kyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rtogs shing snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba bya ba grub pa'i ye shes yin pas gong gi ye shes de'i phrin las kyi cha yin pas dag snang gi rgyas thebs pa gal che/ chos dbyings ye shes ni/ gang tshe nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib/ /thams cad las grol de yi tshe/ /rnal 'byor pa mchog rdo rje can/ /shin tu rnam dag ces bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan par gsungs pas gong gi rang ngo shes pa'i ye shes kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag tshe rig pa'i stong cha chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba de la bdag 'dzin dang chags sdang gis ma gos pas nyon sgrib dang /

'khor gsum mam gzung 'dzin gyis ma bslad pas shes sgrib dag pa la chos dbyings ye shes su 'jog pa yin pas rang gi 'khor 'das dbyer med bsgom pa la ye shes lnga tshang bar shes nas mngon byang lnga'i sbyang gzhi lnga tshan bco lnga tshan pa lnga sbyangs nas ye shes lnga'i gzugs brnyan zla ba/ nyi ma/ phyag mtshan sa bon/ de gsum ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa dang lnga'i rnam par shar ba yin snyam du gzhi lam 'bras gsum bsres nas dag snang gi rgyas ma thebs par sbyang gzhi rnams dang sbyong byed so sor sbyar nas ye shes lnga rim can du bsgom tshe rgyud gsum bsres nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i ngang nas sgom pa lta bu mi 'gro bar rnam rtog brtsegs nas bsgom pa las dang po pa'i nyams len lta bu 'gyur nyen che bas sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas 'bras bu lam byed kyi rtsi dang ma bral ba gal che/ rje bla ma'i zhal nas/ sngon dus dang por bsgom pa lta bu ma yin par rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa rnams kyis ye shes lnga mtshon tshul/ kha dog 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don lta ba'i ngang nas ma g.yos bzhin da lta khrigs se 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ sku'i rnam 'gyur sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa zhes sogs chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi nyams rnams rnam pa gzhi dus dang mthun par snang yang lam khyer gyi stobs kyis ngo bo 'bras dus kyi sku dang ye shes dngos yin pas tha mal gyi zhen 'dzin spu tsam gyis ma gos pa zhig dgos/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs byed pa de tha mal pa'i chags pas gos mi rung zer ba'i don yin/ snyoms 'jug mngon rtogs snyoms 'jug gi sgras de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs pa de gzhi rang ngo shes na 'bras bu myang 'das logs na med pa mtshon byed myang 'das 'khor bar mar bsre ba dang /

slar yang bar do'i rnam shes bsre ba de 'khor ba myang 'das la yar bsre ba'i gnad yin/ mchan/ gi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa de dag snang gi rgyas legs par thebs na rang las gzhan pa'i ye shes pa med par go ba'i gnad yod/ bar do'i rnam shes yig 'bru'i rnam par zhal du zhugs/ yab yum gnyis rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler sgom pa de ma dag pa 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang rnams rang ngo legs par shes na sku dang ye shes las logs na med cing / lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang ba'ang ngo bo rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i don yin/ lha mo bzhis glus bskul ba de chos sku las gzugs sku'i snang ba 'byung ba de snying rje'i rtsal las 'char ba la dgongs/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs nas sems dpa' sum brtsegs sgom pa de lus ngag yid gsum dus gcig la grol dgos pa'i don yin/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dkar po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du 'gyur ba la dgongs/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sngon por bzhengs pa ni chos sku las 'bras bu gzugs kyi sku 'byung ba mtshon byed pas sngon por 'byung ba'o/ /mchan/ rang nyid kye rdo rje lha dgur sgom pa dam tshig sems dpa' sku/ de rnams kyi thugs kar sa bon sgom pa ye shes sems dpa' gsung / klad kor rnams ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' thugs mtshon byed yin pas lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes dang ma bral na thams cad lhar gsal 'ong bas snod bcud sbyang ba/ tshogs drug gi yul la yengs na tha mal snang zhen gyis bslu bas sgo srung gi tshul du skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa/ nyams len de lta bu dang ldan na rang las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas phyi rol na med pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas pa de rgyu'i theg pa ltar lam la rim gyis bslabs nas sangs rgyas pa ma yin par gzhi 'bras bsres nas btsan thabs su rang ngo shes nas grol ba'i don yin no/

/lus dkyil ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gi ni cho ga yang / /lus kyi de nyid mi shes pas/ /de dag thams cad 'bras med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs nyi zer dang bde chen bcud snying gnyis su phyi dkyil las lus dkyil zab pa'i rgyu mtshan gsungs pa rnams nges par byas/ 'khor 'das dbyer med sgom dus phyi na gnas tshad lus la tshang / lus la tshang tshad sems la bag chags kyi tshul du yod gsungs pa de bsgom pa'i man ngag gis nyams su len tshul ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rten dkyil 'khor bzhi dbang rten khog pa dang bcas pa la tshang / gsang ba sems kun gzhi'i gsal cha la bag chags kyi tshul du tshang / sems kyi gsal cha de skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i rig stong brjod du med pa'i ye shes las nam yang g.yo ba med/ de bsgom pa la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi khrid thob dgos/ de la thog mar lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum/ de'ang rgyu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum/ lam lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum/ 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum ste gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi dbye ba yod pa man ngag gis gcig tu dril nas bsgom pa'i nyams len byed pa lus dkyil bsgom pa 'di yin/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sa bon lus la tshang zhing der rlung sems rgyu 'grul gyis ma dag pa'i snang ba shar ba kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams kyi snang ba 'char tshad lus la rtsa yig gi tshul du tshang zhing / der rlung sems cung zad dag pa rgyu 'grul gyis nyams snang 'char ba lus thabs rgyud/ mthar thug sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba 'byung ba'i rgyu lus la rtsa yig gi tshul du yod pa la shin tu dag pa'i rlung sems kyi stobs kyis sku dang zhing khams kyi snang ba 'byung ba 'bras rgyud yin la/ de gsum gcig tu bsres nas bsgom pa mtshon bya mtshon byed bsgrigs pa lta bu mi go bar tshad ma bzhis gtan la phab nas yin pa la yin par shes pa'i go ba zhig med thabs med/

saṃ pu ṭa las/ e ni sa ru shes par bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya spyan ma nyid/ /ces sogs kyi don bshad na/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum dang / rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhir 'khor lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhir bsgom pa des khams gsum rigs drug gi ma dag pa'i snang ba 'byung ba'i rgyu'i rtsa yig rlung sems dang / nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag par byed/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi gnad thams cad tshad med bzhi dang / phar phyin bzhir 'du bas de dag kyang 'dir tshang la/ sngags kyi theg pa'i lam thams cad phyag rgya bzhir 'du zhing / de'ang nyams len 'di la tshang ba yin pas mdo sngags gnyis kyi lam thams cad kyang lus dkyil bsgom pa 'di la tshang / de'ang gnad bsdus na/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje la tshad med bzhi tshang / lta ba'i ngang nas ma g.yos par dge ba sgrub pa la phar phyin drug tshang / de thabs kyi phar phyin yin/ mi mthun phyogs kyis mi brdzi ba stobs kyi phar phyin/ gang zag des gnas kyi smon lam thams cad 'grub pa smon lam gyi phar phyin/ bdag med gnyis rtogs kyi lta ba'i ngang nas ma g.yos pa ye shes kyi phar phyin/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang mi 'bral zhing snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shes pa phyag rgya bzhi yin pas bzhi tshan gsum po 'khor lo so so la sbyor bar mdzad kyang 'khor lo gcig la gnad thams cad tshang ba yin no/ /'bras bu sku dang ye shes zhing khams dang bcas pa lus dkyil bsgom pa 'di la tshang zhing / de lta bu'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum bsre ba la rten dkyil 'khor bzhi sku bzhir thag chod cing / brten pa rang rig pa'i ye shes spros pa dang bral ba rten dkyil 'khor bzhi dang dbyer med du rtogs nas zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa 'di la bdag 'dzin gnyis dang gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang gya nom lhar zhen gyis ma bslad par dag snang gi nga rgyal 'dzin shes na lus dkyil gyi go ba dpyis phyin pa yin no/

/de bzhin du 'khor lo gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre sbyar shes par bya/ de ltar bsgom pa'i phan yon rten 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa yig rlung sems rnams lhar bsgom pa des ma dag pa 'gro ba rigs drug gi rten du gyur pa'i rtsa yig rlung sems rnams sku dang ye shes su bsgom par song bas rigs drug gi gnas sogs 'khrul snang thams cad sbyang ba yin no/ /sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i sku dang zhing khams thams cad 'di las logs na med par shes pas zhing sbyong ba'ang 'grub pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i rten dkyil 'khor bzhi brten pa sems dang bcas pa'i gnad shes nas lus dkyil bsgom pa 'di la/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ bskyed rim bsgom pas 'dod yon lam du byed/ /rdzogs rim thabs kyis nyon mongs byang chub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phan yon 'byung bar ma zad/ lam 'bras las/ lam 'jug ldog dang phyag rgya 'jug ldog gsungs pa'i don 'di lta bu'i gnad zin nas bsgom pa'i tshe dbang gong ma gsum gyi ye shes 'dren nus na lam gong ma ma bsgoms kyang chog pa dang / lus dkyil bsgoms pas bde stong gi ye shes bskyed nus na dbang gsum pa'i lam gyi go chod ces pa lta bur go rung / lus sems gnyis grub bde rdzas gcig yin pa'i gnad kyis lus zag med 'ja' lus dang / sems rtog med chos skur grol ba dus gcig la 'ong ba yin no/ /lam zab nang ma 'dir bsgoms na ngor chen gyis lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bcud bsdus pa lta bu'i gdams ngag yin gsungs pa'i don/ gang zag dbang po rab kyi lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di la dbang bzhi'i lam gnad thams cad tshang bar shes dgos pa dang / mchog sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs rnams kyi don tshang bar shes dgos par gsungs pa yin no/ /da ni dbang len pa la/ dbang zhes pa'i go don sngar ma rig 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa de rang ngo shes nas rang dbang thob pa ngo sprod pa'i don yin/

des na gang zag dbang po rab dbang dus su grol ba dang / 'bring don gyi ye shes dang dpe'i ye shes ngo 'phrod pa/ tha ma sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa la 'jog mdzad pa yin/ brgyud pa 'di'i bka' srol la/ dbang lam du bya ba zhes lam dus kyi dbang rgyas bsdus thun bzhi sogs nyams su len pa 'dis dam tshig nyams chag gso ba dang / 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i dran pa gso ba dang / ye shes kyi gsal snang 'dren pa'i thabs khyad par can zhig yin pas/ khe che la nyen chung ba rang gi rgyud tshod la shin tu mtshams pa yin no/ /'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba la go myong ha cang med cing mos gus kyis dbang blangs te dam tshig gso bar 'dod na/ yig cha rnams las dbang lha'i gtso bo de rang gi bla mar sgoms gsungs kyang gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs thams cad rtsa ba'i bla mar bsgom pa lam zab kyi khyad chos yin pas shin tu legs te sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched rnams sbyong byed dbang bskur zab mo'i thabs kyis sbyang 'bras sku dang ye shes su byin gyis rlobs pa yin snyam du mos gus kyis dbang len pa la dam tshig gso ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing / 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba la 'dris goms cung zad byas nas lta thog nas bsgom pa tshol ba'i tshul gyis dbang len na/ rang gi sbyang gzhi phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga'i 'khrul snang dbyings su dag pa'i ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i rgyal ba'i rigs lnga dang / de bzhin du rang gi 'byung ba lnga dang tshad med bzhi bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang lnga'i mi mthun phyogs kyi 'khrul snang rnams dbyings su dag pa'i ngo bo yum bzhi'am lnga dang / phyi nang gi skye mched bcu gnyis kyi 'khrul snang dbyings su dag pa'i ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' dang lha mo'i tshogs dang / rang rgyud kyi nyon shes kyi sgrib pa rnams dang tshigs chen bcu gnyis rnams su nad 'du ba bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsa mdud yod pas de dag gi rlung sems rgyu 'grul gyi dbang gis phyi nang gi bar chad rnams 'byung bas 'khrul snang de dag dbyings su dag pa'i ngo bo khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs te/

bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs te/ de la 'khor 'das gnyis kyi mchod pa thams cad bdud rtsi lnga dang ye shes lnga'i ngo bor shes pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i mchod pas mchod cing / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan mdor bsdus na ye shes lnga'i nang du 'dus par shes nas/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs gdan gsum tshang ba'i bstod pa'i sgo nas bstod de/ 'khor ba thog med kyi dus nas 'khrul pa'i 'khrul snang 'di rnams bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs las ngo sprod kyi dbang thob pa'i skad cig la sku dang ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba'i dbang yon du lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa dang bcas pa maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du phul nas dbang len pa yin no/ /'og tu ming dbang gi mjug tu dbang gi ngo sprod/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rang la snang ba'i phung khams skye mched thams cad bla ma'i drin gyis rang ngo 'phrod na lhag pa'i lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha dang ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pas rang gi rnam rtog gi rnyog pas ma bslad par rang bzhin gyis dag pa la dag par shes pa'i dag snang gi sgo nas bsgom dgos pa yin/ de'i tshul ni/ mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi skabs su/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad lus la rtsa khams kyi tshul du tshang / lus la tshang tshad sems rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug gam brgyad po da lta'i shes pa'i gsal cha 'di la bag chags kyi tshul du tshang bas/ sems kyi gsal cha de skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i ngang las nam yang mi g.yo bar shes pas snang cha phyi nang gi lha thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum du yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshul gyis gsal 'debs shing byin gyis rlobs pa ste/

de'ang bdag mdun tha dad du 'dzin pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang nyon mongs pas ma bslad par/ de bzhin gshegs pa lngas bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i tshe dug lnga dang phung po lnga'i 'khrul snang dbyings su dag nas bdag mdun tha dad med par rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur byung snyam pa dang / yum lngas rdo rje'i glu len pa'i tshe tshad med bzhi'i mi mthun phyogs dang 'byung ba lnga'i 'khrul snang sbyangs nas dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i rang mdangs yum lnga'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs song snyam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod tshe nang gi tshogs drug gi 'khrul snang dbyings su dag ste gang shar bde ba chen po'i ye shes su ngo 'phrod byung snyam pa dang / khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa'i tshe bdag 'dzin dang chags sdang gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad glo bur gyi 'khrul snang yin pas 'khrul rtog dang de'i gzugs brnyan phyi nang gi bgegs thams cad dbyings su dengs song snyam pa dang / lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i tshe yul drug gi 'dod yon gyi snang ba la gnyis 'dzin gyi zhen pas lhad ma zhugs par 'dod yon rgyan du shar te mchod bya mchod yul la bzang ngan tha dad med pa'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa yin snyam pa dang / dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ phyi nang gi lus lhar smin/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ phyi nang gi ngag sngags su smin/ snying ga yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ phyi nang gi yid chos skur smin/ lus thams cad gang / dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum cha mnyam rlung dang bcas pa ngo bo nyid skur smin te lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag par mos te dbang len pa 'di la dbang bzhi ka'i gnad tshang bar lam du khyer shes na smin grol chig chod du gyur nas dbang gong ma'i ye shes kyang 'dren nus pa yin no/

/rje btsun gyis/ lam thams cad gcig tu bsdebs nas ston pa 'di rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i lugs yin gsungs pa'i don yin/ 'di dag gi skabs su sems rig stong gnyis su med pa ma bcos lhug par bzhag de la bdag 'dzin re dogs gnyis 'dzin gyi lhad zhugs ma zhugs bya ra yang yang byed/ bdag nyid phyi'i he ru ka lus dkyil dang bcas pas dbang len pa yin pas lha brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun nam mgron thabs kyi lha dang 'khor lha mo brgyad kyis len na lha brgya dang gya bdun snang la rang bzhin med par shes nas rang dang dbang lha tha dad du'ang 'dzin mi shor bar dbang len pa la goms dgos pa yin no/ /de nas rin 'byung cod pan gyi dbang la/ tha mal gyi snang ba swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ de'ang 'di'i sbyang gzhi tshor phung dang nga rgyal ser sna yin/ tshor ba bde sdug bar mar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'di tshor phung yin par ma zad/ phung po gzhan bzhi dang khams skye mched rnams kyang 'dir 'dus pa shes dgos/ de'ang ji ltar shes na/ tshor bar snang bzhin pa'i rtog pa 'di la phung po gzhan bzhi e tshang brtags pas go de'ang tshogs drug gi shes pa gang rung gi sgo nas skye bar shes pas skye mched tshang / de'ang khams 'byung ba'am bco brgyad gang yin brtags na tshang bar shes sla/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa 'di nang gi rten 'brel shes pa'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa 'di shin tu gnad che/ de'ang lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum ngo 'phrod pa la thug yod/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug gsum las nyon mongs nad gdon gsum dkyil 'khor bzhi lus ngag yid gsum gyi snang ba 'char tshul 'di shes na phung khams skye mched thams cad nang gi rten 'brel gyi dbang gis 'char bar shes/ lhan cig skyes pa'i chos nyi shu rtsa bdun don du rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang bar shes na sbyang gzhi yang 'di yin la/ sbyong byed lam lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum yang rang sems skad cig ma gsal tsam 'di'i glo bur gyi dri ma cung zad dag pa'i snang brnyan tsam du zad cing /

sbyangs 'bras 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum glo bur gyi dri ma ma lus pa dag pa la sangs rgyas zhes ming btags pa yin gyi gzhan du btsal bas rnyed pa ma yin no/ /'khor 'das zhes pa rmongs ma rmongs sam ngo shes ma shes kyi khyad tsam yin pas/ rig pa skad cig ma'i snang cha 'di bdag 'dzin re dogs gnyis 'dzin gyis ma bslad par rin chen 'byung ldan zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bskyed nas bdag mdun tha dad du ma shor bar dbang blangs te nyams len gyi rgyun de mnyam rjes thams cad du skyong shes na lta sgom spyod gsum gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len pa'i man ngag gi gnad thun mong ma yin pa yin no/ /dbang bskur/ glu blangs/ bkra shis brjod/ bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa dang bcas te chu rgyun gcig la dbang bzhi len pa 'di tshig zin la yod med gang ltar yang gong 'og thams cad du dran dgos te/ phung khams skye mched kyi dri ma thams cad sbyong ba dang lam thams cad gcig tu bsre ba'i gnad yin pas so/ /'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang dang / don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang yang de'i rigs 'gre sbyar la/ don grub kyi sbyang gzhi 'du byed kyi phung po bdag 'dzin dang bcas pa'i rtog pa bzang ngan thams cad kyis las gsog pas 'du byed kyi phung po yin/ de'ang sdig pa'i phung po ri rab yod kyang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod de dag snang gis lam du khyer shes na bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su gnas 'gyur 'gro ba yin pas gsang sngags kyi lam gyis skad cig la sangs rgyas zer ba'i gnad 'di 'dra la thug yod/ rnam snang gi sbyang gzhi gzugs phung de sems snang tsam du shes na gong ma rnams dang gnad gcig yin/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi sbyang gzhi phung po lnga'i chos nyid de dbyings spros pa dang bral ba lhar bskyed mi btub pas phung po lnga'i chos nyid blo la shar ba'i sems kyi gsal cha de lhar bskyed pa yin/

rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig sbyin pa'i tshig lan gnyis byung ba'i don ni/ mtshon byed brda'i rdo rje lag tu gtad de/ mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje rig stong spros pa dang bral ba ngo sprad de 'di'i ngang ma shor ba gnas thub na sangs rgyas rigs lnga po'ang 'dir 'du zhing / sdom pa dang dam tshig gi gnad kyang 'dir 'du la/ ye shes lnga po'ang 'di rang yin gsungs pa yin no/ /thog mtha' med pa sogs kyis sems la dang por skye ba dang bar du gnas pa mtha' mar 'gag pa med par shes pa'i dpyad bsgom dang / gsal stong zung 'jug ma bcos par 'jog pa'i 'jog bsgom gnyis kyi sgo nas skyong shes dgos pa yin/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig 'di ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis mtshon byed brda'i dril bu lag tu gtad de lta ba'i dran 'dzin ma shor bar ngag gi brjod pa thams cad grags stong dbyer med dril bu'i sgra bzhin du yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i sngags mtshon bya don gyi dril bu ngo sprod pa yin/ skyong tshul snga ma dang 'dra/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig rang nyid lha skur bskyed/ rdo rje thugs dang dril bu gsung gi mtshon don dang ma bral bar lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes su khyer shes na tha mal snang zhen gya nom lhar zhen gnyis kas mi brdzi zhing bskyed rim gyi sdom pa'i ngo bo mthar thug pa ngo 'phrod pa yin no/ /gsang dbang la/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyis tshad ldan bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi byang sems ril bu/ rang gi bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes yod na de'i gsang chab yan chad bsags la/ de la gdan gsum tshang ba'i ye shes pa dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag ste rang gis myang / des rang gi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi gdan gsum tshang ba dam tshig pa la byin gyis brlabs te rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag lus zag med 'ja' lus dang /

sems rtog med chos skur grol song snyam du mnyam par bzhag rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa dang / rang gi mos gus kyi stobs kyis ye shes skye zhing rlung gtum mo'i rdzogs rim thams cad kyi smin byed du 'gro ba yin pas deng sang 'di gnad du che bar sems/ dbang gsum pa la/ rang nyid gdan gsum tshang ba'i he ru kar gsal btab/ rig ma'ang gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha mor bskyed/ byang sems gdan gsum tshang ba 'bab bzlog gi sgo nas nyams myong dpe'i ye shes bskyed pa yin mod/ deng sang lag len la thebs pa dka' bas mos pa yid byed kyi tshul du 'don bsgom byed/ rtog pa'i sgo nas 'ching grol du 'gyur ba las dngos po la ngo bo'i sgo nas 'ching grol med/ rnam pa ji ltar snang yang thabs la mkhas pas lam du khyer shes na zag med bde ba'i nye rgyur 'gro ba yin/ 'o na dbang gsum pa'i nyams myong med pa la/ de la brten nas bzhi pa'i ye shes ji ltar ngo sprod ce na/ nyams myong mtshan nyid pa med kyang go yul tsam po la bzhi pa tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprod pa yin/ rang gis dmigs pa legs par 'dzin shes na ye shes skye ba yod de/ grol lam la brten nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba la mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes skye ba du ma yod pa'i phyir te/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pas ye shes ngo 'phrod pa bzhin no/ /de ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs pa'i dus su phung khams skye mched lha dang ye shes su shes pa'i bskyed rim gyi sdom pa dang / rten dkyil 'khor bzhi brten pa rang rig dang bcas pa dbyings dang rig pa gnyis su med pa'i bde stong mchog gi ye shes su ngo 'phrod pa'i rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa'i thob blo bskyed dgos/ de nas dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin pa khas len pa de dbang dus su sku dang ye shes ngo sprad pa'i ye shes de rjes thob tu'ang mi brjed par snang ba'i chos la rgyas 'debs shing nyams su len pa la gtso bor go dgos/

de nas gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ slan chad bla ma'i bran du khas blangs/ de nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha rnams 'od du zhu/ ye shes kyi chur gyur pa lha dgu lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa de bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus dang gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs dbyer med pa'i dbang lha de rnams rang sems dag pa'i snang brnyan tsam las phyi rol tu 'dzin mi 'chor ba'i dgos pa dang / rgyas gdab 'di tha mal snang zhen kun brtags la/ snang ba thams cad lhar shes pa'i gzhan dbang gis rgyas gdab/ lha'i bye brag mang po rnams rigs drug tu 'dus par go ba'i phyir gzhan dbang la gzhan dbang gi rgya rigs drug gis rgyas gdab/ de thams cad chos nyid las mi g.yo bar shes pa'i ched du gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyi rgya rigs bdag gi spyi bor phyag mtshan bsgom pa yin/ de'ang rigs brgya rigs gcig tu shes nas zhal phyag gi spros pa'i gya nom lhar zhen spong ba'i dgos pa yod/ de'ang bshad na/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems goms pa mthar phyin pa dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang / spros pa dang bral ba'i shes rab gnyis zung du 'jug pa kye rdor yin/ lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes su goms pa mthar phyin te sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba gsum dang dbyer med du gyur pa gsang 'dus yin/ 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal thams cad rang ngo shes te bde stong mchog gi ye shes mngon du gyur pa bde mchog yin/ dus gsum dus med du rtogs pa dus kyi 'khor lo yin/ de lta bu'i stobs kyis sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i bdud thams cad bcom pa gshin rje'i gshed yin pas mchog sgrub pa'i lha rnams thugs dgongs gcig yin/ rje bla ma'i zhal nas/ de ltar dgongs pa gcig yin mod/ gnas skabs gdul bya'i bye brag dang / sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi dbang gis rnam 'gyur tha dad dang sgrub thabs sna tshogs nyams su len pa dgos pa che ba'i nyams myong khong la yod gsungs/

lus rten 'di nyid kyi steng du dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ngo 'phrod de mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes 'di med thabs med de/ bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ /sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med/ /ces sogs du ma dang / rtsa rgyud las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs pa bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / dbang gsum pa'i dus dang thabs rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor goms pa dang / rang nyid kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa la rag las par gsungs pa'i phyir/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i thabs spyir 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu sangs rgyas kyi phrin las su shes pa dang / da lta dus ngan pas skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs kyi bla ma gtan nas mi rnyed/ rang rgyud la 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i rtogs pa rgyud la bskyed mkhan nas bzung ste smin grol gnyis kyi lam ston mkhan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen de rnam pa snang tshul ji ltar bstan kyang ngo bo sangs rgyas thams cad dang khyad par med par shes pa 'di cis kyang med thabs med/ de yod na ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren thabs gang gis byed nges pa med de/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ snga ma'i las 'phro'i bye brag dang / /nang gi rten 'brel khyad par gyis/ /ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren ni/ /thabs kyi dbye bas byed par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bla ma la sangs rgyas su mthong nas bla mas gsungs pa'i rang gi dge sbyor thams cad bla ma'i rnal 'byor du shes nas rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs nus na thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres nas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes nang nas 'char ba yin no/ /dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag song nas bdud rtsi myong ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag 'di go dka' bas cung zad bri na/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dngos sam/

de'i ngo bo 'od zer ljang gu 'phros te mdun gyi nang mchod dang rang rgyud kyi gzung 'dzin tha mal du 'dzin pa'i bgegs rnams la a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ de'i ngang las rang rgyud kyi dge ba la spro ba'i brtson 'grus mtshon byed yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang rgyud kyi ye shes mtshon byed me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ngo shes na snod bcud thams cad bde ba chen po'i ye shes su mtshon byed thod pa dkar po/ de'i steng du mngon byang dang po mtshon byed zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du phung po lnga nyon mongs pa lnga 'byung ba lnga sogs sbyang gzhi mtshon byed sha lnga/ de'i steng du sbyong byed ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi lam mtshon byed bdud rtsi lnga/ de'i steng du sbyang 'bras sku dang ye shes mtshon byed yig 'bru lnga/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mtshon byed oṃ dang nyi ma rdo rje gsum/ rang rgyud kyi brtson 'grus kyi rlung g.yos te ye shes kyi me sbar nus na 'khrul snang thams cad sku dang ye shes su byin gyis rlobs nus par mtshon byed sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams khol zhing 'od du zhu/ rang rgyud la mos gus dang rtogs pa cung zad skyes tshe des rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar mtshon byed rlangs pa gyen la song oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag rang rgyud la rtogs pa skyes tshe rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs ye shes pa dang rang sems dam tshig pa dbyer med du 'gyur bar mtshon byed rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros te bdud rtsi ye shes pa spyan drangs/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa sngar gyi bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres te bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa de'i steng gi nyi mas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mtshon/ de'i steng gi rdo rje dang 'og gi oṃ sha lnga sogs kyis so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mtshon/

ro gcig tu 'dres pas bya grub ye shes/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pas chos dbyings ye shes mtshon pas rang nyid mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas lhar bskyed pa dang nang mchod byin rlabs 'di gnyis go ba gcig yin/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi mchod pa la/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs kyang bden stong sgyu ma lta bu/ mchod rdzas kyang bden stong sgyu ma lta bu/ rang nyid lha sku yang bden stong sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i snang ba sems sgrub ma byas pa'i 'khor gsum yongs dag zhig dang / snang ba sems/ sems sgyu ma sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bdag mdun mchod rdzas tha dad du mi 'dzin pa'i 'khor gsum yongs dag gnyis las rang lugs phyi ma yin/ sngags rgyud sde'i dgongs pa nyams su len pa la phyi ma 'di shin tu zab/ cho ga'i dngos gzhi la lnga bsres drug bsres bdun bsres sogs kyi bshad pa 'byung ba snang sems bsre ba'i thabs khyad par can yin pas so/ /bdud rtsi myong ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag yin tshul gzhung na gsal la/ legs par bsams na lha yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs yin/ de bzhin du mchod pa don grub dang / bstod pa rin 'byung gi yan lag gnyis kyang tshig don la zhib tu dpyad na rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du 'khor 'das tshang tshul shes na gnad 'dra ba yin no/ /rdzogs rim bsgom tshul gzhan du gsal/ 'dir bskyed rim la sems 'dzin byed na lha'i nga rgyal bsgoms pas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin drung nas 'byin pa zhig dgos/ bdag med mas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa de bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dang nam yang 'bral ba med pa'i don yin/ gzhan yang lha nam bsgom yang bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang ma bral ba zhig med na bskyed rim rang rgyud du gol ba yin pas lha'i zhabs non du bdud dang ro gdan 'byung ba de'i mtshon byed yin no/ /dag pa dran pas chos kyi bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen po byed dgos pas/

snying rje'i spyan ni sogs kyis stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa lhag pa'i lha'i ngo bo yin pas zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgoms pas tha mal snang zhen sbyong zhing / de'i dag pa shes pas gya nom lhar zhen yang spong nus pa yin no/ /de nyid gsum ni spyan gsum mo zhes zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba de lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes dang nam yang 'bral mi rung ba'i don yin mod/ 'on kyang lta bsgom zung du 'jug pas gya nom lhar zhen gyis ma gos pa zhig dgos/ mdor na 'bras bu'i dag pa ston byed zhal brgyad kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam thar brgyad kyi 'bras bu'i dag pa ston byed yin pas/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas btab nas dag snang la 'bad/ phyag bcu drug gis stong nyid bcu drug dang zhabs bzhis bsdu dngos bzhi dang / rgyan drug gis phyin drug gi dag pa ston pa'i skabs rnams lam gyi dag pa ston byed yin pas/ rang rgyud la yon tan de dag e tshang ba lta dgos pas stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa dag snang gi thabs mkhas kyis zin pa zhig rang rgyud la e yod blta dgos/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te zhes sogs rgyu'i dag pa ston byed skabs 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgyas btab nas ma dag pa'i snang ba la dag snang sbyong dgos/ tshig don rnams 'grel par gsal/ 'dir 'phros don cung zad gleng na/ phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /zhes gsungs pa'i don rang rgyud la sbyor ba'i tshul ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lta bas zin pa'i nges 'byung bcos min zhig rang rgyud la skyes tshe nyan thos kyi theg pa rang rgyud la tshang / snang ba sems su shes nas rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung ldog sems thog tu bsgom shes tshe rang rgyal gyi lam tshang / 'di sngags la sbyar na gong rigs lnga'i dbang gi skabs bden bzhi lto sbyar nas rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta bas lam du byed tshul bla mas gsungs bden bzhi rten 'brel thams cad rig pa skad cig ma gcig gi ngang du tshang bar shes dgos te/

sdug bden gyi rtsa ba ma rig pa dang / rten 'brel lugs 'byung gi rtsa ba der thug pa'i phyir/ rten 'brel lugs ldog gi ma rig pa 'gags pas sdug kun gnyis chod pa'i lugs ldog mngon gyur gyi sdug bden sku/ kun 'byung ye shes su gyur pa'i sku dang ye shes dbyer med rig stong dbyer med kyi ngang du gcig par shes dgos te/ rgyud las/ byis pa mi shes kyis sgrib pas/ /'di yi 'gro ba mi shes pas/ /'gro ba drug gi srid pa'i mthar/ /gang zhig rmongs pas 'khor bar gyur/ /rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas na/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ mchan/ shing rang gis smra nus kyang zhib tu ma bris/ lta bas zin pa'i bcos min gyi lhag bsam bzang po skyes tshe theg pa chen po'i lam tshang / ma dag pa'i snang ba la lha'i 'du shes mi skye zhing gtsang sme'i rtog pa shin tu rags tshe bya rgyud nyams su len/ ma dag pa'i snang ba lhar sgom tshe 'gyur du rung ba'i dag snang cung zad skyes tshe spyod rgyud sgoms/ de la ye shes sems dpa' bcug tshe re zhig lha'i dag snang 'char la yengs pa'i tshe mi 'char ba'i dus rnal 'byor rgyud sgoms/ mnyam rjes thams cad du lha'i snang ba 'char tshe rnal 'byor bla med nyams su len zhing tshang ba yin pas theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi sogs rang gi rgyud la sbyar nas nyams su len pa las kha phyir bltas kyi bshad bsgom lo chen rin chen bzang po la jo bo rjes lo tsā ba rul gsungs dgos pa'ang gnad de 'dra ston byed yin/ dag pa dran pas kyang tshul 'di ston te g.yas kyi phyag mtshan brgyad kyis nad brgyad mtshon zhing srog chags rnams kha nang du lta bas sems can gyi sdug kun rang la len pa phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyi nyams len rang la yod pa mtshon zhing / srog chags rnams thod pa'i nang du bzung bas mdo phyogs kyi nyams len de gsang sngags kyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pas rang snang dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba'i rang snang la sdug kun gyi ming yang med par mtshon/

g.yon gyi phyag mtshan lha brgyad kyi zhal phyir phyogs pa des bde ba chen po'i ye shes snying rje zung du 'jug pa des las bzhi'i 'phrin las lhun grub kyis gzhan gyi don byed pa mtshon pa bzhin no/ /bzlas pa'i skabs rang yi dam gyi lhar gsal btab ste de'i nga rgyal 'dzin bzhin bzla ba dang / sngags kyi sgra grags stong la sems gtad de bzla ba dang / sems lta ba stong nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas bzla ba rnal 'byor gyi bzlas pa dang / thugs srog sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng bkod de de la sems gtad nas bzlas pas rang shugs kyis ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang / 'od zer spro bsdu la dmigs nas bzlas pas las bzhi'i 'phrin las 'grub pa dang / sngags phreng 'khor ba khyogs kyi bzlas pas bde stong gi ye shes skyed pa sogs yin mod/ 'dir rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa tshar chen gyis mkhyen brtse la gsungs pa dang / bla ma'i dgongs pa bsdebs nas bshad na/ yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ yig las sngags phreng baiḍūr+ya'i phreng ba lta bu gcig rjes su gcig mthud pa kha dog sngo la 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba yum gyi zhal nas 'thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi klad kor la thim/ yang zhabs kyu nas 'thon/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i am̐ gi zhabs la thim/ rang rgyud la bde stong gnyis kyi ye shes rim can du skye ba lta bur mkhyen brtses gsungs kyang lhan cig tu skye bar dmigs na bde/ de'i dus 'od dmar po des lus kyi nang thams cad gang / rang snang ma rig 'khrul pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas snod gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad yi dam gyi lhar bsgyur/ mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba til gyi gong bu kha phye ba lta bur gnas pa la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de dag gi byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i ye shes 'od zer gyi rnam pas rang la thim pas rang snang ma rig pa'i 'khrul pa dbyings su dengs/

snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar/ gtso bo'i zhal brgyad dang 'khor lha mo brgyad snang srid lhar gsal ba dang bcas pa'i zhal nas sngags gsungs shing snang srid thams cad bkra lam me gsal seng nge lha sngags ye shes su dus gcig la dmigs nas bzla ba 'di mchog sgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa lta bsgom zung du 'jug pa 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi bzlas pa bya ba yin/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags gsungs par dmigs pa de la 'gyur khyad dang nus pa shin tu che bar rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang po'i gsung na gsal/ rig stong gnyis su med pa'i dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog cing gsal stong zung du 'jug pa sdug bsngal bden pa sku dang kun 'byung bden pa ye shes su shar ba'i lta ba'i ngang nas bzlas pa byed cing snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shes na bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyang de yin pas 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang sbrags nas las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub pa 'di rgyal ba'i phrin las da lta nas lam du byed pa yin no/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshe lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la bsdus nas 'jog pa 'di bsdu rim gyis nyal ba'i rnal 'byor byed pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor mkha' spyod ma dang mgon po sogs gang gis byas kyang btub pas 'dir dkyil 'khor bsdus nas slar thun mtshams kyi lhar langs na legs par gsungs/ spyir bsdu rim 'dis 'chi ba sbyong ba yin pas bskyed rim la gsal snang cung zad yod nas bzung bsdu rim 'di shin tu gnad che/ 'di gnad che bar zhu chen gyis gsungs yod ces rje bla mas gsungs/ rdo rje'i glu len pa 'di bzang ngan dang gtsang sme 'khor 'das kyi 'dzin pa thams cad ro snyoms pa'i ched yin pas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i ngang ma shor ba 'don dgos/ de nas dkon mchog gsum gyi shis pa brjod pa de sgrub thabs 'di'i dbu zhabs thams cad dkon mchog gsum po rang snang du shes pa'i thabs man ngag zab mo yin pas rang ngo 'phrod pa'i dga' ston lta bu lags/

mdor na dkon mchog rjes dran las/ mi mthun pa med cing 'dus pa dang ldan pa zhes gsungs pa'i don gdul bya'i khams dbang dang bstun nas gsungs pa'i chos tshul thams cad khrid tshul mi 'dra ba ji ltar yin kyang sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs yin par thams cad mthun zhing lam gong mar song tshe 'og ma'i yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul du 'dus pa dang ldan pa zhes gsungs pa yin pas rang gi rgyud tshod dang bstun nas chos nyams su len dgos/ dper na dam ye bsre ba 'di la mtshon na rang tha mal dang ye shes sems dpa' tha dad du 'dzin pa yod tshe rang dam tshig par bskyed pa la ye shes pa yang yang gzhug pa 'di gnad che ste/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi dngos po yis/ /lcags ni gser du byed pa bzhin/ /ye shes sems dpa' bcug pa yis/ /mi yi lus la sangs rgyas byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i tshe lus tsha zing nge 'ong ba sogs dag snang cung zad skyes na mos gus lam du longs shing lta ba klong du ma gyur pa'i rtags yin/ dam ye bzang ngan du 'dzin pa zhig nas mnyam rjes med par 'byams na ye shes pa gzhug mi dgos pa yin no/ /de bzhin du gzhan rgyud kyi dkon mchog gsum mngon du gyur pa'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis rang rgyud kyi dkon mchog gsum rang ngo 'phrod tshe rang gzhan gyi rgyud tha dad med par thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin du gnas 'gyur 'gro ba yin no/ /lam 'di'i rjes thob kyi nyams len gtor bsngos 'don tshe/ mdun mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum sum brtsegs sgom pa de khams gsum gyi snang ba thams cad rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin du shes pa mtshon byed dang / steng ma la sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad/ bar pa la thugs rdo rje lha dgu dang phyogs skyong brgyad/ 'og ma la gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad bskyed/ 'byung po brgyad gsum nyer bzhi la khams gsum gyi sems can rnams bstim/

de'i skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes pa spyan drangs te bstim/ lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad par dmigs nas mchod gtor 'bul ba 'di snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shes pa'i thabs/ rgyud las/ nga las 'gro ba thams cad 'byung / /nga las gnas gsum po yang 'byung / /nga yis 'di kun khyab pa ste/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin gzhan ma mthong / /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin zhes rje bla mas gsungs/ de bzhin du lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i don yongs rdzogs gang zag gcig gis stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa la lam sbas bshad zer ba lam sbas bshad kyi/ dkyil 'khor lnga la bstun te bskrun/ zhes pas lus dkyil 'khor lnga la lus dkyil bsgom zhing dbang thun bzhi blangs bas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa bstan/ 'bar g.yo brtan pa'i bye brag gi /zhes 'bar ba drod chung ngu / g.yo ba drod 'bring / brtan pa drod chen po ste 'jig rten pa'i lam gsum bstan/ srog rtsol 'gags pa'ang de bzhin te/ /zhes 'jig rten pa'i lam du ma zad de bzhin te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sa bcu gnyis bgrod par bstan/ bde chen chos sku'i nam mkha' mthong / /zhes pas 'bras bu bstan pa ste lam 'bras kyi lam yongs rdzogs sbas te bstan pa dang / lam zab lta bu la'ang gnad 'di tshang zhing khyad par lam zab nang mar shin tu gsal bar bstan pa'o/ /gsungs/ yin pas 'dir phyogs mtshon pa tsam ni smras yod/ zhib par ni brjod kyi mi long ngo / /kho bos byas pa'i lam rim smon lam du/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ye shes kyis/ /rjes thob snang ba'i chos la rgyas 'debs shing / /chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas/ /mtshan rtog 'khrul 'khor 'jig par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa dag bya dag byed ngo 'phrod pa'i ye shes mnyam rjes gnyis su skyong thub pa dang / snang ba thams cad mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes su 'char ba'i gsol 'debs yin/

yang / snang srid dag pa lha yi 'khor lor rdzogs/ /rtsa thig rlung gi dwangs ma mchog skur smin/ /'khor 'das ye shes gcig gi ngo bor bzlums/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa rten dkyil 'khor bzhi sku bzhi dang brten pa rang rig pa'i ye shes shin tu rnam dag ngo bo nyid skur mngon du gyur te dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes mthar phyin nas 'khor 'das thams cad ye shes gcig gi ngo bor rtogs pa lam 'di bsgoms pas 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur ba'i gsol 'debs yin no/ /de nas rigs su skye dang sogs kyis lam rim gyi smon lam gdab/ rjes thob tu yengs mi 'chor ba'i ched du skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas 'khor gsum yang dag gi bsngo ba byed pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ mi bzad las ngan khur gyis ches non cing / /rmongs shing som nyi'i drwa bar tshud pa yi/ /byis pa'i skye bo bdag 'dra'i kha sgo nas/ /sbas don zab mo'i legs bshad mi 'byung mod/ /drin can bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /mi phyed gus pa'i bsam sbyor ma nyams shing / /thugs brtse'i thugs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i mthus/ /smras pa'i tshig la skyon gyis sbags pa med/ /sngon gyi las 'phro smon pa'i bye brag dang / /rang gi mos gus dad pa'i nyer len dang / /lha dang bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gtam 'di gleng ba'i go skabs bdag gis rnyed/ /rgyud tshod dman zhing sbyangs pa chung ba'i phyir/ /rang mgo mi thon gzhan mgo 'don pa yi/ /nyams len med pa'i kha chos bshad 'dod kyis/ /mkhas rlom grags 'dod 'ur chem ma yin yang / /bla ma'i thugs sras mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje chos kyi blo gros kyi/ /bka' stsal spyi bor gus pas blangs nas ni/ /lhag bsam dag pas tshul 'di yi ger bkod/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun gong ma dang /

/rgyal bas lung bstan kun mkhyen e waṃ pa/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug tshar chen chos rje sogs/ /brgyud 'dzin gong ma'i dgongs pa 'khrul med yin/ /legs gsung sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /tshad ldan gong ma'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi/ /man ngag snying po gcig tu bsdus pa yi/ /dus gsum rgyal ba gshegs pa'i lam chen yin/ /'khor 'das dbyer med bden gnyis zung du 'jug /rim gnyis rnal 'byor lta bsgom zung 'jug gi /dbang bzhi'i lam gyis sku bzhi ngo sprod pa'i/ /gsang chen snying po'i myur lam mthar thug yin/ /skye 'chi bar do'i 'khrul snang zhig pa dang / /las nyon sdig ltung dri ma 'khrud pa dang / /tshogs gnyis dga' ston myur du spel 'dod pa'i/ /skal bzang rnams kyis tshul 'di nyams su longs/ /rang gi sdom gsum dam tshig gso ba dang / /dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs rgyud bskul ba dang / /bde chen ye shes 'char bar 'dod pa yis/ /nyams su longs dang nam yang bslu ba med/ /skal bzang blo gsal rdo rje'i mched rnams kyis/ /dpal mgon bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de/ /dngos su mjal ba'i mos gus bskyed mdzod dang / /gsung gi gnad la nor 'khrul ye nas med/ /rang gi rgyud na nyams rtogs ma mchis kyang / /mdo rgyud gdams pa'i gnad la goms pa'i mthus/ /da dung bdag la legs bshad yod mod kyang / /mnyam 'grogs dbang gis don du mi 'gyur bas/ /dgos pa chung phyir rgyas par 'dir ma bris/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du/ /zab don snying po yi ger bkod pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba mtha' yas gang thob des/ /skye dang skye ba'i phreng ba thams cad du/ /rje btsun bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /'brel ba thogs pa'i sems can ma lus pas/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang myur du 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 7'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros kyis 'di bzhin bris shig ces bri gzhi'i shog bu dang bcas bka' lung rdo rje spyi bor stsal ba gus pas blangs te/
